parameters.subject: Recurring Booking Confirmation
parameters.html:
={{ 
"Dear " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.customer_name + ",

" +
"Thank you for your payment of £" + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.payment_amount + ".
" +
"Transaction Reference: " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.txn_reference + "

" +
"Your recurring booking for the " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.room_name + " is confirmed.

" +
"Session Details:
" +
"Date: " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.booking_date + "
" +
"Time: " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.start_time + " - " + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.end_time + "

" +
"Remaining Balance: £" + $('Code: Logic + Ref').first().json.balance_due + "

" +
"We look forward to hosting you!

" +
"Best regards,
" +
"The VenueDesk Team" 
}}
